## Instructor Utilization - Dashboard

Open the **Dashboard Link** production URL in a browser. It is protected by HTTP Basic Auth, so you choose the username and password in the **Basic Auth** credential. No password is stored in this workflow.

1. **Config** sets the API URL, `lookbackMonths` (default 13) and `namesFirst`, the number of instructors whose names are looked up (default 1000).
2. **Build Window** works out the default view (last 13 months) and the Prior year preset.
3. **Fetch Instructor Names** / **Resolve Names** look up the names of current instructors live, so names are never stored in the cache.
4. **Read Cache** / **Load Cache** read the records the Builder workflow saved.
5. **Build Dashboard** / **Serve Dashboard** return a self-contained Chart.js HTML page with teaching hours and days per instructor.

**Before running:** run the Builder workflow once. Attach your Administrate OAuth2 credential to **Fetch Instructor Names** and a Basic Auth credential to **Dashboard Link**. Select the same cache Data Table in **Read Cache**.
